## Summary

Describe the user-facing and technical change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed the relevant Bari Vara UX reference(s).
- [ ] English and Bengali implications are covered.
- [ ] Financial/history behavior and migration impact were reviewed.
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, and confirmation states were considered.
- [ ] `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .` passes.
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes.
- [ ] Relevant unit/widget/integration tests pass.
- [ ] Offline behavior and sensitive logging were reviewed.
